package.name: panda_block_planner
package.description: A blocks-world state-transition system (E, A, gamma) and a search over it, driving the Panda arm in Gazebo. The robot is given a goal rather than a sequence: it perceives the blocks, abstracts them into a state, plans a run, executes one action, and re-plans against what actually happened. Reuses the scene, robot description and grasp plugin from panda_block_stack.
